request.description: Retrieve individual payment items within a mass payment with optional status filtering and pagination support. Each item represents a distinct payment with status indicators (failed, pending, success) showing whether a transfer was successfully created. Returns paginated item details including amount, destination, metadata, and error information for failed items. Supports filtering by status and standard pagination.

request.description: Retrieve detailed information for a mass payment by its unique identifier. Returns the current processing status (pending, processing, or complete), creation date, metadata, and links to the source funding source and payment items. Use this endpoint to monitor mass payment processing progress and determine when to check individual item results.

request.description: Update the status of a deferred mass payment to control its processing lifecycle. Set status to `pending` to trigger processing and begin fund transfers, or `cancelled` to permanently cancel the mass payment before processing begins. Only applies to mass payments created with deferred status. Returns the updated mass payment resource with the new status.

request.description: Create a mass payment containing up to 5,000 individual payment items from a Dwolla Main Account or Verified Customer funding source. Supports optional metadata, correlation IDs for traceability, deferred processing, and expedited transfer options including same-day ACH clearing. Returns the location of the created mass payment resource with a unique identifier for tracking and management.

Use this endpoint to check the processing status and details of an individual item within a mass payment batch.

request.description: Retrieve all previously created mass payments for a Verified Customer account with optional correlation ID filtering and pagination support. Mass payments are returned ordered by date created with most recent appearing first. Returns paginated results including mass payment status, metadata, source funding information, and item links. Supports standard pagination parameters and correlation ID search for enhanced traceability.
